integrity: Standalone checker uses exact rational finite graph enumeration and was executed successfully. Infinite claims are supported by the analytical proof, not by finite testing.
scientific_limitations: The p=1/4 variance transition and r=1 formal coefficient were already predicted by Bhat et al. (2016); additions are exact closed moment recurrences, full r-dependent rigorous asymptotics and an L2 martingale limit. No CLT or limit law identification. Independent validation not performed.
title: Rigorous quarter-threshold and martingale limit for edge-count fluctuations in parent-linked duplication graphs
